steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What does all of that... mean?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: 'Rhodes Island, we invite you to fight with us.'

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: That's what I said.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: I only speak Ursine. You also asked me in Ursine, so you should have understood.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You know these Chernobog industrial machines much better than us, yes? You must have had a lot more training in such things than we have. We're better fighters.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If you want into the tower, you must have a plan to shut down this thing too. You can't let it close the way.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We need to split our guerrilla forces, sending at least three quarters of our men to protect the Infected around the city, or they're doomed.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Reunion under Talulah is out of control. We've seen enough revenge killings in Chernobog.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Even with just a fourth of our full strength, we have what it takes to beat Talulah's stupid guards. But...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We could use some help right now. We'd be able to better capitalize on our victories if we had it.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Our Originium Altars are down. The devils are handy in a fight, but they've got nothing on the Captain's legendary strength.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We need more firepower.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Who calls the shots for you? Is it the Cautus? Or the Feline? You're both plenty strong, you could handle it.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You'll have to ask Amiya. I'm just an operator.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Cautus, what do you say?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Sir, what matters is if your Reunion is still dedicated to helping the Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: As long as it's not some Infected Ursus political project... we'll proudly agree.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... I'm worried...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: About what?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There are still a lot of open wounds from our conflicts with Reunion. We can't overlook them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We could say we're willing to forgive, or beg forgiveness, but we have to think about those we lost, or who suffered.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Especially...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Reunion killed my friend. And we just killed someone you looked up to.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Hrm.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I get it... I killed your family, didn't I?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You can't forgive that.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But you're Infected!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If we don't let you in, we're disobeying orders.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Our current orders are to crush Talulah and her minions. And anyone who disobeys that order is to be killed.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: So you're letting it go? Can you... let it go?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Yes, you killed our family. You killed our commander, our leader, our Captain.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But we're not going to come to blows over it.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You don't want revenge?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Of course we do. I'm not done yet, let me finish, Feline!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But whatever we've got between us personally doesn't matter in the face of the mission.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: There's a more important place to direct our hate.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hate...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You get it, don't you, Feline? That Cautus with you is a kid with her head in the clouds, just like the Captain said.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Don't talk about Amiya like that.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If you really buy into her dreams of reforming everybody, then by all means, go along with her.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You'll get stabbed in the back, and you won't know until it's too late. You won't be able to save your friends. It all sounds good in theory, but you can't really put it into practice.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: And us, we believe in the Captain. All this way, he's shown us a different way, beyond the endless wars of Ursus.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: He showed us a noble path of revenge and ruin.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A path of ruin?!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: To ruin our enemies.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: How to pick out your enemies and then ruin them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But who is your enemy? Can you really act like it's a good thing to spread hate, hurt people, start wars, and generally cause misery?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Haven't you lost enough friends? Didn't Ursus...?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: The last emperor promised us an end to this war! We believed in that vision.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But I don't see an end in you. Should we reason with them? They don't listen. Some people are asses, and some are just evil and need to die.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Listen to me, Feline!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You won't get the satisfaction you want from killing your enemies. For the simple reason that that's not where it ends.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If you're committed to that path, then take it all the way, kill everything, cleanse the country of its filth and when at last you look over the silent white field of snow... then you can finally know happiness!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Think about it. And then we start killing.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Kill the monster in the tower who sent our people to die, kill the tyrants who lord over the cities, kill the useless eaters, and the traitors in the army!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: And at last, kill the miserable Ursus ministers who poison the Emperor with their lies. Kill them all!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Then you look back and see what you've done! See those who deserved to live on, their peaceful lives, free from the fear of starvation being forced upon them.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: I mean, that's what you're doing here, right?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You kill those who kill your friends!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You want to kill Talulah.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Obviously!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: What else would we want? Will the Captain ever be able to rest in peace as long as she lives? What about Yelena and her Yetis? Or the countless Reunion brothers who she used as cannon fodder?!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We've been waiting for a savior, a good emperor, a hero... and we're sick of waiting.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: What did all that waiting get us?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Our great Emperor is fallen, with no one to carry on his legacy, with greedy, self-interested men fighting over the scraps, ripping our country in two and milking the people dry!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Our savior was buried alive, and our hero died right in front of us!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Not that you would understand.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But maybe you'll understand something else. Feline, have you ever lost a loved one?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: I can see it in your eyes.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'm done talking to you.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: But you'll listen, Feline. You have the eyes of a warrior.

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: The sealing layer is still rising...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: It hasn't stopped at all.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It'll take some time to adjust the Originium drive.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: It better not take too long. If this thing seals up, then all the hope of a trial goes with it for at least a few hundred years.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So you guerrillas don't just fight for the Infected.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Obviously!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: The Infected are just one reason to fight. You can have as many as you want!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: The one and only reason we took to the tundra was the injustice and disorder of Ursus. The Captain told us the Infected didn't have to live like this, it's Ursus that tortures the Infected to achieve their ends!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Picture it, our great march... the Captain brought us all here, could that really just be for the Infected?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We crossed from border to border, passing by all the hardened cities, taking control of the lifeblood of the Empire, uniting to strike at the heart of the rotten country...!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Don't tell me you've never considered it, Cautus? You're not like this just because you're Infected.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If they treated everyone right, equally, maybe you wouldn't have even gotten infected.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Think about it, how many city dwellers, nobles, merchants, and performers get infected?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: And then how many out in the wilderness, the outskirts, and the mines?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: That's why we need to get revenge!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: On who?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Everyone who gets in our way!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's not right!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Don't you hate the people who made us what we are?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not talking about righting the wrongs of the Infected! I mean it's wrong to turn this into like, a way to blow off steam, that's what's wrong...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: They did this to us, for their own sakes!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: They turned us into monsters! And... and I hate them.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Preach, Feline.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...That's not right......
I'm sorry.
This is going to hurt.
I'm sorry... Amiya. This shouldn't have happened to you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's not right.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But... Amiya, why do you say that?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Don't you think we should hate them? You can't say they didn't steal our lives from us.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I don't want to forget... I don't want to forget my friends and family!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I could have worn clothes I liked, and gone to the school I wanted. I could have gotten to know my mom and dad and everyone, I could have...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I could have... my brothers... *whimper*...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis, calm... calm down!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I can't...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I can't.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I won't let this go, Amiya... I can't!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: If I have to get hurt to protect them, if I have to suffer to keep them from suffering...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Then I'll take it all!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: If killing the people who ruined our lives would make you all feel even a little better, and if you're not willing to do it, then let me do it for you!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Rosmontis, Amiya, we've got a transmission from the engineer team!

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Something weird's happening, the drive system isn't moving!

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: ...Is it the enemy? Captain, if you can hear me, this is...

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: No! They must be...

steps.name: Rosmontis Squadmember
steps.text: Captain! Look out for Ur—

steps.name: Woman's Voice
steps.text: Get back! Jump! Hurry!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: What happened? Come in...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Do you copy?! Lavaca! Bluishsilver!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No, no no no...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: The sealing layer is still rising!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Did the engineer team... get ambushed?)

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No, it can't be. Bluishsilver, she... I'll can't reach her, I can't feel her anymore!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...Prepare the explosives. Let's blow the whole joint.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we destroy the sealing layer, it will take a few blocks with it. And there are still some Infected who didn't want to join Reunion hiding in the area!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: There's no time. If we keep waiting only more people will die!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We've lost comms!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If you don't like my plan then give us a better one!
No.
Absolutely not.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I get where you're coming from... I dunno. It's just...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: My team... my squad... I...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: They did everything right! How could this happen to them?!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: If you need strength, if you need to destroy, I can do it! I can do it better!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Ah... ahhh!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis! Curl your fingers!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I just... tear... destroy...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Wha... the sealing layer's stopping?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I CAN DO IT!!!

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: An explosion?! No way. The Feline, she... how is she tearing that thing apart?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: ...What... how...?

steps.name: Phantom Crossbowman
steps.text: It's almost like...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Shh!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: (Shakes his head)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: It's just like the first time you saw FrostNova and Talulah, isn't it?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Just wait until our infections get worse... maybe you'll see some more.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: *Pant*, *pant*... I...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya... I... I'm cold... My head...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis! I've got you! Hold on tight, don't let go!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: She shredded the sealing layer all by herself?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Not for long, but it should be enough to get us through the sector.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I need a medic!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Hnnngh... Aaugh! It's scratching me, scratching at me!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: These are negative emotions and side effects of direct Arts... They all have to do with Bluishsilver's memories.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis... Look at me. Look at my eyes!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: (The black lines flow from the finger of the Lord of Fiends right into the Feline's eyes...)

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: (She really is...)

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Nnnngh... I know... Amiya... I know...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't ever do that again! B-But, even if I tell you, you'll...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Uh huh... S-Sorry... I won't change. Heh.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Well done, Feline! You really did it!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Brothers, let's move out! Through the fire and the hail of bolts, we go!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You should rest here for a while, Rhodes Islanders.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Just give me a minute, guerrilla fighter?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We don't have a way to stay in communication. Even the operator with you there doesn't have the comms we need to carry out this operation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If the Shieldguards really need our help... Then you have to know what we're going to do, at least.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Good thinking. Couldn't hurt to give you a minute.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Especially with all this little Feline did for us.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: (Breathes weakly)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'll be fine. I have to... keep... fighting.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I have to... find... my team.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Okay. I know.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's Madame Ch'en again...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: So you're really going back?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Definitely.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But you told me you don't know if your friend in Ursus is alive or dead. What's the point in going back to Lungmen? Why not go right to Ursus after graduation, then?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ursus wouldn't give someone like me an entry permit.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: No way... Oh, it's really so sad to see you go right after you finish. You're such a clever girl, Chenchen. You'd make senior lecturer in no time!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Give it two years and can go anywhere in the world you want, eh?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't ever call me that again, please.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And what about you?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Me? You know me. I'm not stupid, but compared to you, well... I only eked out passing grades in those joint operations.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You just finished your military strategy course?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Almost failed that one a bunch of times.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You've got a better head on your shoulders than 98% of Victoria. At least on paper.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But I don't see myself becoming a lecturer. I think I'm better off going looking for a fight than setting myself up as a command or logistics officer.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You really don't fear death. A Victorian soldier can end up running into all sorts of things on the battlefield.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But I know our enemies sure as hell don't wanna run into any Victorians soldiers on the battlefield.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What I really worry about is sitting in front of a strategic map messing up my head till I can only see human lives as numbers. That's the scariest thing. A soldier on the front lines needs somebody to tell her what to do, and what not to do.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Only when you're in the thick of it do you see how cruel a war is, and how important it is to stop.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You really want to change Victoria? I thought... that was just a drunken ramble.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Nah, not at all. Is it that weird? I just... want to do some good.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Doing good isn't easy.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But it's the reason I'm going back to Lungmen. Lungmen's had enough of the bad. I'll stay there, fix up the bad things, stop it from getting worse.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: So you're going back to become a cop?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: A cop?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Wow. I always thought you had the look of a girl who could give a good beating to a hooligan. I've got a gift!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're getting ahead of yourself. But the police...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's not a bad idea.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It'd probably be a great place to pick up clues about what happened back then, and what's happening now... I wouldn't have to rely on my old schemer of an uncle.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Honestly I was worried you'd head to military intelligence. My little Chenchen is scary enough, I can't imagine how scary she'd be as a spook.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And I'll have your bloody head off.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Hey! No need to get angry. *Sigh* Alright, I can take it!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Hah. We'll see how much you can take.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh, someone's at the door. Just a sec! Coming!

steps.name: Academy Messenger
steps.text: Message for Miss Ch'en Hui-chieh, post-transcribed. Check your terminal. I have to confirm in person that you've read it yourself.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Why all the trouble? I'll take a look.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...What? What... is this?

steps.name: Academy Messenger
steps.text: I'd say that counts as you having received the message. The academy doesn't review highly classified material, so if you have any further inquiries about the content, I'll advise you to reply to the sender.

steps.name: Academy Messenger
steps.text: Anything else I can do for you? If that's all, I'll be on my way. Have a good afternoon.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: There we go.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Why do they walk so funny?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I don't like the look of your face there. Did that message sock you in the jaw?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't even know what I'm feeling.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: They picked up my friend's trail.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Well isn't that good?!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It just led to her disappearing again. She...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: She... killed the one who took her. And then... we lost her again.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Erm.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: But at least... she's still alive?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's true.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm going right back to Lungmen after graduation.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Huh? But... well, isn't your friend in Ursus? I really thought you'd be heading that way. I was thinking of knitting you a few scarves as a goodbye gift.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I wouldn't be able to do much in Ursus. But back in Lungmen, I'll have a chance to spread my influence. The city of Lungmen is a lot stronger than me alone.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...I am going to find her.
'As move at teardrop's point, once known be deft.'
